FX-SBURST-001.says: As added: a fine field of about 7000 faint star dots, the picture's colours, scattered through the depth and flying towards the viewer.

FX-SBURST-002.says: A close look: about 300 stars, nearer ones larger and further out from the middle.

FX-SBURST-003.says: Scatter 0, Speed 0: the picture as a grid of dots on its own plane.

FX-SBURST-004.says: Scatter 0, Speed 1 at frame 12: the plane of dots half a picture height nearer, so half as large again and spread from the middle.

FX-SBURST-005.says: Scatter 0, Speed 0, Phase 0.5: the same as FX-SBURST-004.

FX-SBURST-006.says: Scatter 0, Speed -1 at frame 12: the plane of dots further off, smaller and drawn in towards the middle.

FX-SBURST-007.says: Size 300: the close look's stars three times as wide.

FX-SBURST-008.says: Blend w. Original 50: the close look half over the picture.

FX-SBURST-009.says: Blend w. Original 100: the picture alone.

FX-SBURST-010.says: The picture with its right half clear: stars only from the left half.

FX-SBURST-011.says: Speed keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 2 at frame 12: the field speeding up.

FX-SBURST-012.says: FX-SBURST-002 moved 3 pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-SBURST-013.says: The composition's camera in the middle, 48 pixels off, as the effect's own eye: the same as FX-SBURST-002.

FX-SBURST-014.says: The camera moved to x 20: the field seen from the left of its middle.

FX-SBURST-015.says: The camera dollied in to 24 pixels off: the near stars nearer, those behind it gone.

FX-SBURST-016.says: In point at frame 6: at frame 12 the same as the close look at frame 6.

FX-SBURST-017.says: Grid Spacing 100: a few large stars, 5 by 3.

FX-SBURST-018.says: Scatter 0, Speed 3 at frame 24: the plane of dots has flown past the viewer and come round again behind, half its size.

FX-SBURST-019.says: Scatter 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SBURST-020.says: Speed 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SBURST-021.says: Phase 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SBURST-022.says: Grid Spacing 0.4, below 0.5. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SBURST-023.says: Size -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SBURST-024.says: Blend w. Original 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SBURST-025.says: Speed keyed to 200 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
